title: Large sculpted spherical afro
caption: A fictional Black woman wearing a large, dense Afro picked outward and shaped into a controlled near-spherical silhouette.
patternDescription: Generated with a dense Type 4C-like coily texture whose tight pattern supports substantial picked-out volume; the image should not be treated as evidence of a real person's natural subtype.
lengthDescription: Substantial coily length expanded outward from the scalp, creating a large silhouette extending well beyond the head in every direction.
